post.hook: A Claude Code leak and an Nvidia board probe
post.subhook: Plus DeepSeek's agent push and new lawsuits against Suno

stories.headline: Claude Code feature reportedly exposed secrets on GitHub
stories.detail: Reports say secrets committed via the 'Don't Ask Again' feature went public. Developers using it should audit repos for leaked credentials.

stories.headline: DeepSeek's Harness agent app tops 1.5M daily users
stories.detail: DeepSeek also plans a plugin marketplace, adding competition in the agent platform market.

stories.headline: Nvidia board investigates Jensen Huang over alleged spy tie
stories.detail: The probe concerns Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Huang has admitted to an affair.

stories.headline: Claude reads bank transactions, but disconnecting leaves a trail
stories.detail: Users linking financial accounts to Claude should weigh how their data is retained after they disconnect.

stories.headline: Elvis Presley and Eminem rights holders sue Suno
stories.detail: The lawsuits target AI-generated music that mimics famous artists, adding legal pressure on music generators.

stories.headline: Apple pushes to make Siri more agentic
stories.detail: Apple's CEO is reportedly pressing for a competitive AI agent in Siri.

stories.headline: Claude adds Project Coordination beta for paid plans
stories.detail: A beta project coordination feature is now part of Claude Pro, Max and Ultra.

stories.headline: Anthropic says Claude generated designs in allergy drug research
stories.detail: Anthropic reports the model was used at scale in early drug design work.

stories.headline: Tencent AI chief warns AI will soon master biology
stories.detail: Tencent's chief AI scientist flags biological safety risks, adding to pressure for safeguards on frontier models.

post.caption:
Check your repos today 🔐 A Claude Code feature reportedly leaked developer secrets, and that tops the list.

1. Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' feature reportedly exposed secrets on GitHub. Audit for leaked credentials. (iTnews)
2. DeepSeek says its Harness agent app tops 1.5 million daily users and plans a plugin marketplace. (SCMP)
3. Nvidia's board is investigating Jensen Huang over a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy; Huang admits an affair. (The Verge)
4. Apple is pushing to make Siri more agentic. (The Verge)
5. Anthropic adds a Project Coordination beta to Claude Pro, Max and Ultra. (TokenPost)
6. Anthropic says Claude generated designs in allergy drug research. (ABC45)
7. Claude can read bank transactions, but disconnecting the account leaves a trail. (Mixed News)
8. Elvis Presley and Eminem rights holders sue Suno over AI music. (The Verge)
9. Tencent's chief AI scientist warns AI will soon master biology and create safety risks. (SCMP)

Rotate your keys, then read the rest.
